info.name: MockServer - Advanced Examples
info.description:
Collection of advanced mockserver examples demonstrating:

**XML Examples with Validators and Processors:**
- Email and age validation with custom error messages
- Order calculations with status validation
- Currency conversion with payment processing

**JSON Examples with Validators and Processors:**
- Product data validation with SKU format checking
- Partial matching mode (allows extra fields)
- Complex checkout calculations with tax and totals

**Key Features:**
- Semantic body matching (format-aware comparison)
- Custom validator functions (raises ValueError on failure)
- Custom processor functions (extracts/transforms data)
- Template variables: BODY_PROCESSED contains processor output
- Multi-field validation with detailed error messages
- Data generation (IDs, timestamps, calculations)

**Starting the Server:**
```bash
python main.py --config-dir config --endpoints-file endpoints_advanced_examples.py
```

**Server URL:** http://localhost:9090

**Health Check:** http://localhost:9090/_health

item.name: XML Example 1: Create User with Validation

request.description:
XML endpoint with semantic matching that validates email format and age range (18-120). Processor generates user ID from email hash and categorizes users by age group.

**Validator Logic:**
- Email validation (must contain @ and .)
- Age validation (18-120 years)
- Required field checking

**Processor Logic:**
- Auto-generated user ID (MD5 hash of email)
- Full name composition (firstName + lastName)
- Age-based grouping:
  - young_adult: < 25
  - adult: 25-39
  - middle_aged: 40-59
  - senior: >= 60
- Timestamp generation

**Expected Response:**
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<createUserResponse>
    <success>true</success>
    <user>
        <id>6579DA5F</id>
        <firstName>John</firstName>
        <lastName>Doe</lastName>
        <email>john.doe@example.com</email>
        <fullName>John Doe</fullName>
        <ageGroup>adult</ageGroup>
        <createdAt>2024-11-23T22:30:00.123456</createdAt>
    </user>
    <metadata>
        <source>web</source>
        <processedBy>mockserver</processedBy>
    </metadata>
</createUserResponse>
```

**Try these variations:**
- Young adult (age < 25)
- Senior (age >= 60)
- Invalid email (missing @ or .)
- Invalid age (< 18 or > 120)

item.name: XML Example 2: Update Order with Calculations

request.description:
XML endpoint that validates order status and calculates totals. Processor computes item count, total amount, and estimates delivery date based on order status.

**Validator Logic:**
- Status validation (pending, processing, completed, cancelled)
- At least one item required
- Positive quantity and price validation

**Processor Logic:**
- Item count calculation
- Total amount calculation (quantity × price for all items)
- Delivery date estimation:
  - pending: +7 days
  - processing: +3 days
  - completed: today
  - cancelled: N/A

**Expected Response:**
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<updateOrderResponse>
    <success>true</success>
    <order>
        <orderId>12345</orderId>
        <status>pending</status>
        <totalItems>1</totalItems>
        <totalAmount>10.00</totalAmount>
        <estimatedDelivery>2024-11-30</estimatedDelivery>
    </order>
    <message>Order 12345 updated to pending</message>
</updateOrderResponse>
```

**Try these variations:**
- Different statuses (pending, completed, cancelled)
- Invalid status (should fail validation)
- Zero or negative quantities (should fail validation)

item.name: XML Example 3: Payment with Currency Conversion

request.description:
XML endpoint that validates payment data and performs currency conversion. Processor converts amounts to VES and calculates processing fees.

**Validator Logic:**
- Currency validation (USD, EUR, VES)
- Amount validation (positive numbers)
- Status validation (approved, pending, rejected)

**Processor Logic:**
- Currency conversion to VES (using mock exchange rates):
  - USD: 36.50
  - EUR: 40.20
  - VES: 1.00
- Processing fee calculation (2.5% of amount)
- Status-based message generation
- Timestamp generation

**Expected Response:**
```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<paymentResponse>
    <success>true</success>
    <transaction>
        <transactionId>ABC1234567890</transactionId>
        <status>approved</status>
        <amount>100.00</amount>
        <currency>USD</currency>
        <amountInVES>3650.00</amountInVES>
        <conversionRate>36.50</conversionRate>
        <processingFee>2.50</processingFee>
        <customerId>12345</customerId>
        <processedAt>2024-11-23T22:30:00.123456</processedAt>
    </transaction>
    <message>Payment of USD 100.00 approved successfully</message>
</paymentResponse>
```

**Try these variations:**
- EUR currency
- Different statuses (pending, rejected)
- Invalid currency (should fail validation)
- Zero or negative amount (should fail validation)

item.name: JSON Example 4: Create Product with Validation

request.description:
JSON endpoint with semantic matching that validates product data. Processor generates product ID, formats price, and determines stock availability.

**Validator Logic:**
- Price validation (positive numbers)
- Stock validation (non-negative)
- SKU format validation (6-10 alphanumeric characters)
- Required field checking

**Processor Logic:**
- Auto-generated product ID (PRD-XXXXX format)
- Price formatting ($XX.XX USD)
- Stock availability boolean (inStock: true if stock > 0)
- Timestamp generation

**Expected Response:**
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "product": {
        "id": "PRD-45678",
        "name": "Sample Product",
        "sku": "PROD123",
        "price": 29.99,
        "category": "electronics",
        "stock": 100,
        "priceFormatted": "$29.99 USD",
        "inStock": true,
        "createdAt": "2024-11-23T22:30:00.123456"
    },
    "message": "Product Sample Product created successfully with SKU PROD123"
}
```

**Try these variations:**
- Out-of-stock product (stock: "0")
- Invalid SKU (too short or too long)
- Negative price (should fail validation)
- Negative stock (should fail validation)

item.name: JSON Example 5: Search with Partial Matching

request.description:
JSON endpoint using PARTIAL matching mode, which means only the specified fields need to match - extra fields in the request are ignored. Processor generates mock search results with pagination.

**Matching Mode:** PARTIAL (allows extra fields in request)

**Validator Logic:**
- Price range validation (minPrice < maxPrice)
- Pagination validation (positive page and limit)
- Category validation

**Processor Logic:**
- Mock result generation based on category
- Total results calculation (random based on category)
- Total pages calculation (totalResults / limit)
- Price range formatting
- Sample product generation for results array

**Expected Response:**
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "filters": {
        "category": "electronics",
        "priceRange": "$10.00 - $100.00"
    },
    "pagination": {
        "page": 1,
        "limit": 10,
        "totalPages": 16,
        "totalResults": 156
    },
    "results": [
        {
            "id": "PRD-12345",
            "name": "Sample Electronics Product 1",
            "price": 55.0,
            "category": "electronics"
        },
        ...
    ],
    "message": "Found 156 products in category electronics"
}
```

**Try these variations:**
- Different categories (books, clothing)
- With extra fields (partial matching ignores them)
- Invalid price range (minPrice > maxPrice)
- Different page numbers and limits

exec: pm.test("Subtotal, tax, and total calculated", function () {

request.description:
JSON endpoint that validates cart data and calculates order totals. Processor computes subtotal, tax (16%), total, and generates order/transaction IDs.

**Validator Logic:**
- Cart validation (at least one item)
- Item quantity/price validation (positive numbers)
- Payment method validation (credit_card, debit_card, bank_transfer, paypal)
- Email validation

**Processor Logic:**
- Total items calculation (sum of all quantities)
- Subtotal calculation (sum of quantity × price for all items)
- Tax calculation (16% of subtotal)
- Total calculation (subtotal + tax)
- Order ID generation (ORD-YYYYMMDD-XXXXX format)
- Transaction ID generation (TXN-XXXXXXXXXXXX format)
- Delivery estimation based on payment method:
  - credit_card/debit_card: +2 days
  - bank_transfer: +5 days
- Timestamp generation

**Expected Response:**
```json
{
    "success": true,
    "order": {
        "orderId": "ORD-20241123-4567",
        "customerId": "12345",
        "totalItems": 2,
        "subtotal": "51.00",
        "tax": "8.16",
        "total": "59.16",
        "currency": "USD",
        "paymentMethod": "credit_card",
        "estimatedDelivery": "2024-11-25",
        "createdAt": "2024-11-23T22:30:00.123456"
    },
    "payment": {
        "status": "approved",
        "transactionId": "TXN-A1B2C3D4E5F6"
    },
    "message": "Order ORD-20241123-4567 created successfully. Total: USD 59.16"
}
```

**Try these variations:**
- Different payment methods (bank_transfer, paypal)
- Multiple items with different quantities
- Single item
- Invalid payment method (should fail validation)
- Empty cart (should fail validation)
